tap.scope: Complete static instrument runtime: HTML, Sentinel writer, manifest, icons and inactive original service worker. Development tools/tests are not runtime dependencies.
tap.license_note: No root LICENSE or NOTICE was supplied in this pinned archive. Preserve embedded attribution; no new blanket license is asserted.

previews.scope: Complete Surface, Manifest, Display, Communicate and Science static pages and their model, core and stylesheet dependencies; original provenance and all supplied upstream license/notice files.
previews.license_note: Upstream does not grant a blanket license to imported content. Original Surface MIT and WaxTablet Apache-2.0 license/notice texts are preserved under docs/upstream-notices.

modification_notes.tap-local-lifecycle: Explicitly disable service-worker registration; load the adjacent lifecycle and shared text-status bridge. Track clocks, animation and scheduled tone callbacks; invalidate pending permission/audio work on hide; track and stop audio sources, detach motion/orientation, close audio and clear clocks on pagehide. Preserve canvas, sound, motion, sky and control algorithms. Tap exports no derived measurements.
modification_notes.surface-local-lifecycle: Add an aggregate-only publication hook immediately after the real emit/model-seeding flow, label keyboard output explicitly and untrusted/dispatched pointer events as fixtures, release captured pointers, invalidate pending audio work on hide, cancel animation and disconnect resize/close audio on pagehide. Preserve the original classifier, rhythm, traces, optional tilt and sound.
modification_notes.surface-entry: Load source-preserving adjacent adapters and shared bridge; replace the unavailable upstream hub link with /invariant and a same-origin, active-frame-validated invariant:return/v1 navigation message, without permitting sandbox top-navigation; disclose the bounded same-origin aggregate handoff instead of claiming no transport.
modification_notes.offline-font: Remove only the optional remote Fontshare import; retain the original stylesheet, font names and existing sans-serif fallback so the instrument makes no external font request.
modification_notes.preview-core-export: Adapted original cores with IIFE namespace isolation, actual-page DOM initialization guards, and browser/CommonJS reusable exports. Manifest/Display expose InvariantEvidence (also ManifestCore/DisplayCore) using original content binding, synthetic evidence recomputation, and strict verification; verification snapshots caller input before async hashing. Science exports ScienceCore.inspectExperiment extracted from the original science() comparison; no credit prerequisite and dormant legacy communicate policy stays unexported. Communicate exports InvariantCredit (also CommunicateCore): createEngine() and mounted session use the same original communicate-rules-preview-2 staged action closures, with cloned inspection snapshots and explicit API input/concurrency rejection. Original sample/policy algorithms, preview schemas, pages, limitations and unverified provenance remain retained.

output.activity: Mean energy of the current sixteen model-seeded rhythm cells.
output.severity: Mean severity of the current sixteen model-seeded rhythm cells.
output.occupancy: Fraction of sixteen cells with energy greater than the original 0.03 sounding threshold.
output.unresolved: Fraction of sixteen cells classified as silent unresolved endpoints.

derived_output_contract.limits: Each output is finite in [0,1]. At most four records per second, no queued samples, no contact coordinates, angles, layer bands, orientation values, precise event times, audio buffers, identity or raw histories. This UI-derived chart is not a physical measurement, qualified activation, launch result or sensor calibration.
derived_output_contract.transport: Only parent.postMessage({type:'invariant:instrument-output',record}, location.origin); the receiver must also validate event source, origin and the exact record schema.
derived_output_contract.reciprocal: Only same-origin event.source===parent messages with exact keys type='invariant:derived-input' and status (nonempty text <=240 characters). Presented with textContent and an explicit unverified/non-activation/non-launch/non-calibration prefix; never changes instrument state.
derived_output_contract.lifecycle: Iframe shell must destroy the frame on navigation. Hidden/pagehide stops audio and removes sensor listeners; returning never automatically resumes sensors. Neither instrument uses media capture. Tap emits no record because its native logs include coordinate/sensor-derived fields outside this aggregate contract.
